editorial.tldr: This page mechanically groups four items that share the phrase "large language models" in their title, not one developing story. It runs from an agent-swarm benchmark through an HVAC deployment review to a Zhipu/MiniMax business-model roundup, with nothing connecting them but that phrase.
editorial.whats_new: The three clinical-comparison and medical-hallucination items previously on this page have aged out of the window; the newest item is still Sep 10's domain-specific hallucination detector combining fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3 classification with Monte Carlo sampling.
editorial.why_it_matters: Ranking-by-shared-title-phrase can silently fold unrelated arxiv papers and business news into one page -- treat this grouping as noise, not corroboration, before citing more than one item from it together.
editorial.take_for_builders: Don't treat a shared link on this page as corroboration across sources -- these items are grouped by word overlap only; verify each independently before citing them together.
